name: Westfield Plaza Bonita
description: Westfield Plaza Bonita is a premier shopping destination in National City featuring iconic global brands like H&M, Victoria's Secret, Louis Vuitton, and Nespresso. This Westfield center offers an exceptional blend of fashion, dining, entertainment, and events with time-saving amenities including click-and-collect services and Smart Parking technology.
demographics: Westfield Plaza Bonita serves a diverse, middle to upper-middle income trade area in the South Bay region of San Diego County, attracting families and young professionals from National City, Chula Vista, and surrounding communities. The center's visitor base includes a significant Hispanic population alongside diverse demographic segments seeking value-oriented fashion and mainstream retail options. Primary shoppers are budget-conscious families and millennials looking for a mix of national brands and affordable dining options in an accessible, enclosed mall environment.
